verdict.rationale: Omarchy is built directly on Arch Linux and uses standard Arch package mirrors, supports dual-boot/partition install alongside Windows (Quattro), full-disk encryption, and works on user-chosen hardware from Manjaro to dedicated Arch installs — community reports confirm successful installs across varied setups (comm-7, comm-14, comm-15, comm-20) with no proprietary lock-in beyond standard Arch tooling (comm-3). Minor friction exists (boot splash branding, login-manager overwrite) but the underlying OS remains fully open and portable.
